blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Operatives of the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) have arrested an alleged member of the New People’s Army (NPA) wanted for a 2016 ambush that killed an Army soldier in Agusan del Norte, police announced on Sunday. The 25-year-old suspect, a resident of Gingoog City, Misamis Oriental, was captured around 5:35 a.m. on Thursday, Oct. 8, in Barangay Siana, Mainit town, Surigao del Norte. The manhunt was conducted by the CIDG Surigao del Norte Provincial Field Unit, led by Lt. Col. Darwin Dura, in coordination with the Mainit Municipal Police Station, according to a […]...
